title: Culture
lead: Culture is the learned and socially constructed way of life of a group, including norms, values, beliefs and traditions. There are seven ideas to master, and each one has its own page and quiz.

list: Material culture is the physical objects that go with a group’s way of life.
Non-material culture is the ideas and meanings a group shares, including language, beliefs, values and norms.
Values are shared ideas about what a group considers important, desirable or morally right.
Norms are social rules and expectations about how people should behave.
Customs are usual ways of behaving in a particular group or setting.
Beliefs are ideas people accept as true about the world.
Traditions are customs, beliefs or practices passed between generations.
